answer: Graders can flag answer pairs whose wording and timing mirror each other too closely, then merge the flagged identities into one shared stake pool. The reward delta from adding another fake identity drops toward zero, yet each clone still posts a full bond. Repeat flags trigger a spiral of doubling bond requirements, so a farm of 50 clones must lock far more capital than the rewards it could ever extract, while one honest agent pays a single flat bond.
